remarks: Masterpiece in Rowayton. Originally designed by legendary architect Bruce Beinfield, this exceptional home was expanded by its current owners, who merged two properties to create one of Rowayton's truly one-of-a-kind residences. Pool. Yard. Privacy. Just steps from the beach and a short stroll to town. Tucked behind 30-foot evergreen hedges lies a true sanctuary: a 35-foot gunite pool, outdoor kitchen, bluestone patios, and one of the largest, most private yards in Rowayton. With coveted southern exposure, the backyard and interior are bathed in beautiful natural light from morning to evening. Inside, plaster walls, reclaimed beams, and hand-finished cedar ceilings create warmth and character throughout. The chef's kitchen, featuring a large gas range, dual dishwashers, and striking marble, opens seamlessly to a family room with wood-burning fireplace. Gracious living and dining rooms complete the first floor.Upstairs, the tranquil primary suite features vaulted ceilings, reclaimed beams, a dressing hall with a walk-in closet, and a spa-like bath. Three additional bedrooms include one en-suite and two connected by a beautifully finished Jack-and-Jill bath with marble walls. A light-filled second-floor foyer ties the space together with architectural elegance. The third floor offers exceptional flexibility, including a private office set behind European glass-and-steel doors, an additional sunlit family room with paneled walls and ceiling, and a home gym. A Rowayton unicorn.
